1530737134712131634.title: # EQL AFTERLIFE — Class Combo Cheat Sheet == *Freeport Server • pulled from beta community rankings* - <#1528946135149051991> ## How Trios Work: Pick 2 classes at creation → unlock your 3rd at level 1
1530737134712131634.author: Cytroxian
1530737134712131634.body: # EQL AFTERLIFE — Class Combo Cheat Sheet == *Freeport Server • pulled from beta community rankings* - <#1528946135149051991> ## How Trios Work: Pick 2 classes at creation → unlock your 3rd at level 10 → LOCKED at 11 (choose wisely!). Your primary is race-locked and stays until level 50 (token to change); your 2nd & 3rd swap freely in town. Your armor tier = the highest-tier class in your trio — splash Warrior/Paladin/SK/Cleric for plate. 560 combos exist, so experiment! ## Top All-Around: SK / Shaman / Monk — tank + lifetaps, slow/heal/buff, and top-tier melee DPS. Elite solo *and* group. Warrior / Cleric / Bard — rock-solid & beginner-friendly: tank + heals + passive buffs. ## Best Solo Anchor: SK / Shaman / Rogue — lifetap sustain, slows, and burst. The solo king. ## Caster / Pet Farming: Magician / Cleric / Wizard — pet + heals + nukes; excellent at low difficulty. ## Melee DPS Core: Monk / Rogue / Shaman — heavy sustained damage with slow + sustain. ## Balanced (official showcase): Rogue / Paladin / Wizard — melee + plate + direct damage. ## Control / Utility: Enchanter / Cleric / your pick — buffed charm & pet system; elite haste, mez & control. ## Pro Tips: Cleric & Shaman = the gold-standard support pairing Shadow Knight = the strongest solo anchor Pets currently tank weaker than expected — bring a real tank class for hard content Score your own trio: [everquestguides.com/legends](

1529031598081703977.title: Summary of What's Included in Your Onboarding & BiS Guide This comprehensive PDF onboarding compendium was built specifically for EverQuest Legends (EQL) to distribute directly to your guildmates and
1529031598081703977.author: Cytroxian
1529031598081703977.body: Summary of What's Included in Your Onboarding & BiS Guide This comprehensive PDF onboarding compendium was built specifically for EverQuest Legends (EQL) to distribute directly to your guildmates and friends. It covers mechanics, group configurations, scaling systems, and itemization across every single inventory slot. 1. Core Systems & Game Advice Trio Multiclassing Mechanics: Overview of how characters run 3 active classes simultaneously and how base stats, spell books, and passive masteries combine into a single character profile. Stance System & Invocations: Detailed breakdown of how instant stance-swapping during combat shifts primary roles (e.g., Caster → Soft Tank or Priest → DPS) and how shared invocation cooldowns operate. Top Guide Links & Tools: Links and references to the Official EQL Wiki Database, the Trio Synergy Calculator, Stance/Invocation breakdown guides, and Instance/Attunement manuals. 2. Grouping & Raid Dynamic (4-Man & 8-Man Formats) 4-Man Dungeon Teams: Role allocations (Main Tank/CC, Healer/Buffer, 2x Hybrid DPS) and cross-buffing tactics for dungeons like Lower Guk, Solusek B, Unrest, and The Hole. 8-Man Raid Ensembles: Structure for planar raids (Plane of Fear, Plane of Hate, Plane of Sky, Nagafen/Vox) focusing on stance-offloading, cross-healing, and debuff stacking. Difficulty Scaling (D0–D4): Explains how dungeon instances scale from D0 (Solo/Duo) up to D4 (Hardcore Raid-tier), detailing enemy health/damage scaling and maximum stat-modifier drops.

Complete Best-In-Slot (BiS) Item Tables (All 18 Inventory Slots) Covers all 18 gear slots (Head, Face, Ear L/R, Neck, Shoulder, Arms, Back, Wrist L/R, Hands, Waist, Legs, Feet, Ring L/R, Primary, Secondary, Range, Ammo/Charm) for all major class archetypes: Heavy Armor / Tank Trios (Warrior / Shadow Knight / Paladin Focus) – Max AC, Stamina, and Threat items. Physical Melee & Ranged DPS Trios (Monk / Rogue / Ranger / Bard Focus) – Haste, Strength, Dexterity, and weapon damage ratios. Caster & Spell DPS Trios (Wizard / Magician / Necromancer / Enchanter Focus) – Intelligence, Mana pools, spell power, and casting haste. Priest & Support Healer Trios (Cleric / Druid / Shaman Focus) – Wisdom, Stamina, healing power bonuses, and mana regeneration items.

1530346265844387942.author: Cytroxian
1530346265844387942.body: In beta I found it was a great thing to farm this silk in the Oasis region of the desert especially in high concentration locations dropped more frequently and wonder if harder difficultly yields greater drop rate of this silk? It's an excellent thing to grind up a few stacks of and can sell to merchant for a lot of plat early game. Or, if the in game economy really takes off in North Freeport, EC Market Tunnels, or eventually in the Bazar it would be worth a lot more maybe 2-5x is reasonable over market vendor prices at amiably so to speak con to you. I also found myself killing so many that I would clear as many as I can see close by and then switch layers in a sense, using the "pick zone" action/tool and could find more but some folks camping layers, too. Similar to farming for certain things in World of Warcraft layers and farm spots, too!
